_comment: Screen registry. role+active drive the ONE canonical navigation (see apply-theme.mjs). nav:false = modal or phone capture screen with no sidebar. lens = presents as part of a merged screen. See SOLUTION-AUDIT.md §3.

AiTrust.dc.html._why: AI activity, failure states and audit trail — closes SOLUTION-AUDIT.md §6.1

MemberDetail.dc.html._why: Facilitator drill-down on one team member (from TeamStatus): assigned items + status/progress/blockers, AI daily summary, the member's own yesterday/today/tomorrow stand-up, collaboration cross-links, update cadence, and a recorded contribution log. Detail view — back-link, no sidebar.

UpdateComposer.dc.html._why: Voice-to-AI daily standup capture — the one intentional mobile task flow, reached from MemberDashboard's Update buttons

MyUpdates.dc.html._why: Mobile twin of MemberDashboard (strict subset) — redundant. The responsive MemberDashboard IS the member's 'My work' view and becomes a bottom-bar layout on phones. SOLUTION-AUDIT.md §3.

ItemDetail.dc.html._why: Mobile twin of ItemDetailFull, which already carries the Day-3 AI-detection timeline in a responsive app shell. SOLUTION-AUDIT.md §3.

Team.dc.html._why: Recognition / leaderboard — cut from nav and demo path, SOLUTION-AUDIT.md §5
